description: This file contains unit tests for functions related to redacting sensitive information from URLs, including test cases for redaction functions, URL parameter detection, and configuration path recognition.

methods.name: redactSensitiveUrl
methods.description: Redacts sensitive parts of a URL, such as username, password, and sensitive query parameters.

methods.name: redactSensitiveUrlLikeString
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from strings that resemble URLs, even if they are malformed or incomplete.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlQueryParamName
methods.description: Determines if a URL query parameter name is considered sensitive (e.g., tokens, secrets).

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlConfigPath
methods.description: Checks if a configuration path is related to URL secrets based on its structure.

methods.name: hasSensitiveUrlHintTag
methods.description: Checks if a given tag object contains the explicit URL-secret hint tag.
